Name: Xiddav's Bigger Sheds
Author: xiddav
Description:
The shed walls will match the vanilla farm type. They can also be decorated like vanilla sheds
all other farm types will have a stone floor and wall. works with all farm types.


[b]Basic Shed Sizes[/b]
vanilla: 11 x 9
slightly bigger: 17 x 13
bigger: 30 x 19

[b]Big Shed upgrade[/b]
vanilla: 17 x 12
slightly bigger: 21 x 18
bigger: 48 x 25

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22524]Deluxe Shed :  23 x 18
[/url]slightly bigger: 30 x 30
bigger: 48 x 48





[size=4][b]Config options[/b][/size]
Allow Casks: Neither, Big, Both
default is Neither

I was playing co-op and the bigger shed mod we were using had some issues with missing tiles and building tiles where there should of been front tiles, and no upgraded shed so upgrading made the shed smaller, so I made this.
The size was made for a multiplayer game where we didn't want to make more sheds.

I think it's to big for a single player, but that's up to you.
